# Billiards audio palette

All files are generated by `scripts/build-pool-audio-palette.py` from the
CC0 recordings listed below (downloads live outside the repo; the URLs and
edits are recorded so the palette is reproducible).

## cue-soft-1.wav (cue)
- Source: S02-22 Billiards cue stick hits ball.wav by craigsmith — https://freesound.org/people/craigsmith/sounds/675330/
- License: CC0 1.0
- Edits: sliced 2.594s–2.804s from the recording, converted to 44.1 kHz mono, leading silence trimmed, DC removed, 3 ms/40 ms fades, family-shared peak normalization
